question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Fastidious**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Sloppy)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Fastidious"** means excessively concerned with accuracy, cleanliness, or details; very attentive and meticulous. (अति सूक्ष्म और सावधान) • **Example:** She was fastidious about keeping her room spotless and organized. • **"Sloppy"** refers to a lack of care, organization, or attention to detail; the opposite of being fastidious. (लापरवाह या गंदा) • **Example:** His sloppy handwriting made the document hard to read. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Fastidious"** is **"Sloppy."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Sloppy)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Meticulous** (सावधानीपूर्वक): Showing great attention to detail; very precise and careful. • **Example:** She meticulously planned every detail of the event to ensure its success. • **Fussy** (चुनचुना या झगड़ालू): Hard to please and overly concerned with minor details. • **Example:** The fussy child refused to eat anything but plain pasta. • **Perceptive** (सजग या अनुभवी): Having a keen understanding or insight into something. • **Example:** Her perceptive comments during the discussion impressed everyone in the room. 44:Ta1c, The correct answer is: **Magician**.
